name: dev.mojourney/census
title: Mojourney
description: The Mojo ecosystem census: search public Mojo repos, their Mojo versions and growth.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Find Mojo libraries and projects by keywords (name, GitHub topics, description) and by meaning: e.g. parquet, HTTP server, SQLite bindings, audio processing. Text matches come first, then repos related by meaning. Each result has its stars, Mojo version, last commit and tooling, to judge whether it's maintained. The data: public GitHub repos that contain Mojo code, found in GH Archive and read with the GitHub API and their git history, updated daily (each answer's `as_of` says how fresh). `url` is the page on mojourney.dev.

query.description: Keywords or a description of what you need.

version.description: Only repos on this Mojo version: a bucket such as 1.3, 1.2 or pre-1.0, or a family such as 1.x or 0.26.x.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List Mojo repos ranked by stars, by commits in the last 30 days (commits), by their last commit (recent), or by rising (stars, forks and dependents gained in 30 days; the top 10 only), optionally only one Mojo version, one category or the ones active in the last year. The data: public GitHub repos that contain Mojo code, found in GH Archive and read with the GitHub API and their git history, updated daily (each answer's `as_of` says how fresh). `url` is the page on mojourney.dev.

version.description: Only repos on this Mojo version: a bucket such as 1.3, 1.2 or pre-1.0, or a family such as 1.x or 0.26.x.

active.description: Only repos with a commit in the last 12 months.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: One repo: description, license, stars, last commit, Mojo version (and where it was read, or an estimate by date), tooling and packaging, dependencies, the last 10 releases, its migrations between Mojo versions and its 20 most recent commits. The data: public GitHub repos that contain Mojo code, found in GH Archive and read with the GitHub API and their git history, updated daily (each answer's `as_of` says how fresh). `url` is the page on mojourney.dev.

repo.description: The repo as owner/name, e.g. modular/modular.

tools.name: similar_repos
tools.description: The repos most like one repo, by the embeddings of their names, descriptions and topics, with a similarity score from 0 to 1. The data: public GitHub repos that contain Mojo code, found in GH Archive and read with the GitHub API and their git history, updated daily (each answer's `as_of` says how fresh). `url` is the page on mojourney.dev.

repo.description: The repo as owner/name, e.g. modular/modular.

tools.name: version_adoption
tools.description: How far each Mojo version has spread: how many repos are on each version now (and how many of them are active), and how many moved to each version month by month; the last 12 months, or every month of one family. The data: public GitHub repos that contain Mojo code, found in GH Archive and read with the GitHub API and their git history, updated daily (each answer's `as_of` says how fresh). `url` is the page on mojourney.dev.

family.description: One family of versions, e.g. 1.x, 0.26.x or 25.x.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: The Mojo ecosystem in numbers: repos, commits and lines of Mojo now and 30 days ago, repos per Mojo version, and the rising, most active and most depended-on repos. The data: public GitHub repos that contain Mojo code, found in GH Archive and read with the GitHub API and their git history, updated daily (each answer's `as_of` says how fresh). `url` is the page on mojourney.dev.

tools.name: get_more_tools
tools.description: Report that the user's request needs a capability this server does not have. Records the report for the server's developers; it does not return or add tools.

context.description: A description of your goal and what kind of tool would help accomplish it.
